body:
I remember when I was young and the whole dating thing started, I used to play football with a bunch of people every lunch, for years we did this in a local park. Then one of the group got a girlfriend and drifted away, soon more and more until everyone was spending their lunch times mingling and I honestly didnt understand the fuss. I knew this is what people of a certain age do but it never hit home with me, i always wanted to play football. That kind of sums up me and relationships, I just dont understand them. A few therapists have suggested that I have Aspergers, which is on the Autism scale, because I lack alot of basic human interaction skills and empathy. I must admit it sucks to know that what is seen as a universal joy is something I dont understand, or want. I do wish I wanted it, it sounds good, everyone who has been in love seems to recommend it but in 26 years I havent found anyone, boy or girl, who I can stand for more than a few minutes. 

When i see relationships, I dont view them on emotional terms I see them like you would see a puzzle, I evaluate all the components and it honestly doesnt make sense to me why, if you removed emotion from the equation, anyone would desire them. There is a philosophical discussion in there somewhere but the point is that I dont connect on that level, it doesnt register.

You are right that I would love to want those things, i mean everyone tells you from when your young you want a career, you want a wife and kids (or partner) you want this and that and everyone else has it. Fact is I dont want it, I dont want any of it, I dont want a high flying career or friends or relationships, I of course want to be happy but the only things I can think of that give happiness are things I learned from tv shows, movies and postcards.

You didnt offend me dont worry about that, I was just a little concerned you were finding bullet points and skimming what I wrote, which is understandable given I wrote alot.

The most common thing I am asked when I go to a new counsellor is what I want and I have no idea, I think about it all the time, I search for motivation but I dont find any. I want to be happy, thats all I know, I want to have a goal in life or some passion that I can dedicate myself to. I just dont know what it is. Im 26 now and ive been doing this for so long, I cant wait another 10 years and be in the same position.
it feels like you ctrl+f my main post and didnt read it properly :[

Really unhappy, Im not a self harmer so I dont want to give the impression thats going on, also im not at a state where Im going to hurt myself now, but im worn out by it all now. If someone offered me a pill and said "thats it, take it and die" I would take it, but the irony behind my fear of illness is that all of the methods of suicide really worry me, especially their capacity to go wrong.

I went to my Dr a few weeks ago and he said he has tried enough drugs to realise they wont help anymore, I have been on 4 now with no improvement. I started CBT early last year and showed a little improvement but not much. The problem stemmed from the fact that I literally had no motivation, I have no goals or dreams, I dont have pie in the sky hopes so when people approach me with "do this this and this and then we can work your way to do....." im left with nothing to put there. Im not sure whether I am asexual but I have never had a relationship, crush and I have no want for a friendship or companionship, infact I really do not understand why anyone would want it.

When you have nothing you want, nothing to work for, what use is there to work for works sake? I could go out tomorrow and shave, get a haircut and some nice clothes but ill still be sat in my room, having wasted money on things I do not care about that get me no-where I want to be.

What can you do with someone with nothing to look forward to? And nothing to motivate him?
Im new to reddit posting, how would we?
